description: 新北市黃金資收站資訊-板橋區 [roads, bridges and tunnels] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 新北市政府環境保護局. 為提昇資源回收量、降低垃圾量、落實垃圾變黃金之理念、並鼓舞社區活力、推廣環境教育及改善環境衛生，新北市政府環境保護局從100年8月底啟動「黃金資收站」政策，本政策鼓勵里長設置資收站，里民將資收物帶至資收站，即可秤重、累積點數並換取新北市專用垃圾袋等兌換品；此網頁提供新北市黃金資收站設置資訊。 (板橋區). Coverage: 新北市政府環境保護局. The portal files it under the publisher 新北市政府環境保護局. Its tags are 投資理財. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-06-27 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
